//: Test-only Firebase config for `firebase emulators:exec` (the rules unit tests). Only the emulator wiring lives here — NO `firestore.rules` path, because rules.test.js loads ../firestore.rules itself (readFileSync -> initializeTestEnvironment), so the suite always exercises the shipping rules. Keeping a `firestore.rules: ../...` here would (a) be redundant and (b) be rejected by firebase-tools as 'outside the project directory'. Hosting is intentionally omitted.
